title: ForeplayStaticAdAnalysis
description: Structured extraction schema for Gemini Vision analysis of static / image / carousel ads from Foreplay. Force JSON output mode. Null any field that cannot be determined from the image alone. Do not infer beyond what is visible.

format_archetype.description: Static format archetype. Pick closest match.

headline_verbatim.description: Verbatim primary headline text on the image. Do not paraphrase. If multiple text blocks, this is the largest/most prominent one.

subheadline.description: Verbatim secondary headline if present, e.g. 'These statements have not been evaluated...' or the smaller text underneath the main headline.

primary_claim.description: The single most prominent benefit/claim. Verbatim if shown on image. One sentence.

benefit_bullets.description: List of verbatim benefit bullets if the static is a listicle format. Empty array if not a listicle.

social_proof_type.description: Type of social proof used in the static. 'none' if absent.

cta_text.description: Verbatim CTA wording if visible on the image. Null if no explicit CTA.

color_palette.description: Brief color palette description, e.g. 'cream + dusty rose + olive', 'high-contrast black on white', 'desaturated lifestyle photography'.

carousel_breakdown.description: Only populate for carousel ads. Null for single-image statics.

why_it_works.description: One-paragraph mechanism explanation grounded in what's visible. Why does this static convert? Name the persuasion lever (authority, scarcity, social proof, problem-aware framing, transformation, identity, etc.) and how the visual layout reinforces it.
